# os-homedir [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/os-homedir.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/os-homedir)

> Node.js 4 [`os.homedir()`](https://example.invalid/api/os.html#os_os_homedir) [ponyfill](https://example.invalid)


## Install

```
$ npm install --save os-homedir
```


## Usage

```js
const osHomedir = require('os-homedir');

console.log(osHomedir());
//=> '/Users/sindresorhus'
```


## Related

- [user-home](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/user-home) - Same as this module but caches the result
- [home-or-tmp](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/home-or-tmp) - Get the user home directory with fallback to the system temp directory
